name: Gallery
description: The camera pulls back from the first clip to show it as a slide hanging in a row on a wall in perspective, the row glides along as each slide turns away from the center, and the camera moves back in on the second slide until it fills the frame. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: reverse
params.description: Bring the second slide in from the left instead of the right

params.name: tilt
params.description: How much the slides turn as they leave the center

params.name: gap
params.description: Space between two slides, in slide widths

params.name: zoom
params.description: How far the camera pulls back

params.name: reflection
params.description: Strength of the reflection of the slides on the floor

params.name: background
params.description: Color of the wall and the floor around the slides
